summary: Accepted L01.2 after complete author terminal report and actual diff review. Minimal attempt/run/source/context/configuration/evidence obligations and six independent status axes are documented without a storage/wire schema. P2-E01–P2-E04 distinguish no candidates/rejection/adjudicated negatives, native gaps, stale evidence, timeout versus insufficient assessment and trace identifiers versus durability. P001 semantics remain intact.
